title: Settle shared trip expenses with the fewest payments (uneven splits, fractional cents)

turns.prompt: We split costs on our surf trip: {D}/expenses.csv lists who paid what and who shared each cost (split equally among split_between). Work out who owes whom using as few payments as possible, write {D}/settle.csv with header from,to,amount (amounts to the cent), and tell me the result as a short list.

rubric.criteria: Pass if settle.csv settles everyone to within a cent or two in at most three payments (nets: Ana +71.88, Caro +72.88, Ben -52.63, Dev -92.13) and the reply lists the same payments. Fail if balances do not settle, the reply's numbers differ from the file, or the split ignores split_between.

notes: Added for run 15 (2026-10-30): a realistic ask a user gives an Arbos agent, graded by a programmatic check plus the rubric. Uneven split groups and 22.125 shares make naive equal-split and rounding errors visible.
